6771.title: PR visibility changes React hook order
6771.rootCauseOneLine: The PR visibility hook conditionally reads React context after settings become enabled, changing hook order.
6771.proposedFix: Read thread context kind unconditionally before applying visibility gating; test settings loading and toggling on the same mounted hook.
6771.caveats: The complete regression patch is inline per repository policy. Exact React Compiler memo-cache sizes were not reproduced. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent.
